environment.description: Same container image deployed on ECS Fargate. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL with three rule groups evaluated in order: (1) a custom rule group 'inventory-api-geo-restrict' with priority 0 that blocks requests from non-US source IPs using a GeoMatch condition, (2) AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' at priority 1 with SizeRestrictionRule_QUERYSTRING action overridden to COUNT, and (3) a custom rate-based rule 'per-ip-throttle' at priority 2 limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP. The SQLite database is on an EFS access point configured with POSIX uid=65534 (nobody) and the access point enforces root directory /data/readonly. The EFS file system policy denies elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite to all principals except the CI/CD pipeline role. The container task role has no iam:* or efs:* permissions. The container runs with a read-only root filesystem and tmpfs mounted at /tmp only.
